purpose: Machine-readable source registry for VIN, chassis, and OEM lookup routing.

free_baseline: NHTSA vPIC API for basic VIN/WMI decode, WMI decode, and batch VIN decode
local WMI/platform hints for common AutoStop ROW/JDM patterns
CRM vehicle_profile context with explicit conflict reporting
high_confidence_requires: VIN/frame-specific EPC or commercial catalog confirmation
production date/build window and market/grade/options when parts are VIN-critical
independent source or supplier confirmation before CRM parts writeback

sources.name: NHTSA vPIC API
sources.notes: Primary VIN decode source for regulated vehicles. Supports decode and manufacturer data.

sources.name: NHTSA vPIC Home
sources.notes: Official home for VIN decoding, MID, and downloadable standalone datasets.

sources.name: Toyota Japan EPC Help
sources.notes: Documents Toyota Japan catalog inputs including VIN and frame number search flow.

sources.name: Toyota Recall Search
sources.notes: Useful for Japan-market chassis-number confirmation.

sources.name: Honda EPC Mirror
sources.notes: Public Honda catalog mirror with frame-number search entry and catalog navigation.

sources.name: Honda Recall Lookup
sources.notes: Recall lookup only, but useful as a source-of-truth check when Honda VIN routing is needed.

sources.name: Nissan EPC Mirror
sources.notes: Public Nissan catalog mirror with frame-number search entry and catalog navigation.

sources.name: Nissan Recall Search
sources.notes: Official Japanese recall lookup that accepts chassis or vehicle-number style searches.

sources.name: Mazda Recall Search
sources.notes: Official Mazda recall lookup for Japan-market confirmation.

sources.name: Subaru Recall Search
sources.notes: Official Subaru recall lookup for Japan-market confirmation.

sources.name: Subaru EPC Mirror
sources.notes: Public Subaru catalog mirror with frame-number search entry and catalog navigation.

sources.name: partslink24 Mobile
sources.notes: VIN-scan entry and genuine parts access for participating brands; useful when dealership-grade catalog access is available.

sources.name: partslink24 Product Info
sources.notes: Explains VIN access and original parts access for authorized dealers.

sources.name: MAN Service Portal / webMANTIS
sources.role: Authorized MAN route for VIN- or production-number-specific MAN Genuine Parts identification through webMANTIS and Service Portal vehicle information packages.
sources.access: MAN Service Portal/web shop access; products can be purchased for short durations or via flat rate depending on contract.
sources.limits: Use only with authorized access. Do not use third-party MANTIS installer downloads, cracked EPC databases, or forum mirrors as official evidence.
sources.notes: Primary MAN OEM route when CRM asks for original catalog numbers or MAN service-kit contents.

sources.name: MAN online ordering service powered by partslink24
sources.role: Official MAN Genuine Parts ordering route for independent workshops and fleet operators, with VIN-based part identification and MANTIS basket handoff.
sources.access: Registration at partslink24 plus MAN service outlet/customer number; MAN advertises possible one-month trial access.
sources.limits: Ordering and availability evidence, not a public offline database. Keep credentials/customer data outside Git and CRM summaries.
sources.notes: Use together with webMANTIS or dealer confirmation for MAN OEM lookup and procurement handoff.

sources.name: TecAlliance TecDoc Catalogue
sources.role: Licensed aftermarket catalog and data layer for article/OE-reference/cross/applicability checks after vehicle identity is known.
sources.access: Commercial TecDoc Catalogue or TecDoc data user license.
sources.limits: Aftermarket data; do not treat as the sole OEM EPC proof for configuration-sensitive original numbers.
sources.notes: Useful second layer behind PartsAPI/TecDoc-style adapters and supplier catalogs.

sources.name: MAHLE Aftermarket eCat
sources.role: Official MAHLE/Knecht/Behr catalog for filters, engine components, thermal management, starters/alternators, and related aftermarket parts.
sources.access: Public web catalog; some regional/customer features may depend on TecAlliance or account access.
sources.limits: Use as analog/cross/applicability evidence. Keep OEM candidates separate unless an OEM reference is independently confirmed by a VIN/frame EPC.
sources.notes: MAHLE states its online catalog provides TecDoc-standard spare-parts information.

sources.name: MAHLE Aftermarket official catalog PDFs
sources.role: Official downloadable PDF catalogs for MAHLE filters, gaskets, pistons, rings, thermostats, diesel, and heavy-duty products.
sources.access: Free official downloads; link-only ingestion by default.
sources.limits: Do not commit full PDFs/catalog tables unless owner confirms license and storage intent. Prefer source metadata plus manual citation.
sources.notes: Good offline/manual fallback for filters and heavy-duty catalog checks when live eCat is not convenient.

sources.name: Local offline parts catalog cache
sources.role: Local untracked cache of official public PDF/XLSX catalogs and extracted text for offline cross/applicability checks after VIN/EPC or exact vehicle profile is known.
sources.access: Available only when the ignored runtime cache exists; search extracted text with rg under data/offline_parts_catalogs/text.
sources.limits: Aftermarket/cross/application evidence only. Do not treat local PDF/XLSX hits as VIN-specific OEM proof, and do not paste catalog tables into CRM or durable memory.
sources.notes: Built on 2026-06-05 with MAHLE, Bosch, MANN-FILTER, NGK, Donaldson, and ZF/SACHS official downloadable sources. MAN OEM remains authorized webMANTIS/PartsBase/partslink24/dealer route, not an offline cache.

sources.name: Bosch Mobility Aftermarket catalog / eCat
sources.role: Official Bosch aftermarket catalog/product route for spare parts and vehicle accessories, with regional eCat/AutoParts Catalogue variants.
sources.access: Public regional web catalog; availability and interface vary by country.
sources.limits: Bosch article/applicability evidence, not a brand OEM EPC. Confirm OEM reference separately for VIN-critical work.
sources.notes: Use for plugs, sensors, filters, wipers, brakes, rotating electrics, diesel components, and product verification.

sources.name: Bosch official filter catalogue PDF
sources.role: Official Bosch filter catalog PDF for manual offline lookup and footnote checks.
sources.access: Free official PDF download; link-only ingestion by default.
sources.limits: Large PDF reference; do not paste tables into CRM or commit raw catalog dumps without explicit owner approval.
sources.notes: Use when Bosch eCat is unavailable or a PDF footnote confirms a filter split.

sources.name: MANN-FILTER Online Catalog
sources.role: Official MANN-FILTER route for filter selection, cross-reference, dimensions, and replacement/discontinued checks.
sources.access: Public online catalog; VIN search appears in selected countries/regions.
sources.limits: Filter analog/applicability source. For OEM by VIN, first confirm the genuine reference through EPC or dealer route.
sources.notes: MANN+HUMMEL describes daily-updated catalog data and cross-reference/VIN search capabilities.

sources.name: Hengst Online Catalogue
sources.role: Official Hengst catalog for filter vehicle search, product search, and cross-reference lookup.
sources.access: Public online catalog.
sources.limits: Use as filter analog/applicability evidence, not as sole OEM EPC evidence.
sources.notes: Catalog page identifies Hengst as a TecDoc data supplier and exposes vehicle/product/cross-reference search.

sources.name: Donaldson Shop / official filter catalog
sources.role: Official Donaldson route for filter part search, cross-reference, equipment search, attribute search, and product literature.
sources.access: Public browsing plus account features depending on region.
sources.limits: Use for filter/filtration analog confirmation. Verify heavy-duty VIN/service-kit splits against OEM EPC or supplier evidence.
sources.notes: Useful for trucks, off-highway, hydraulics, air, oil, fuel, and specialty filtration.

sources.name: Fleetguard official catalog and product search
sources.role: Official Fleetguard route for filters, product literature, dealer lookup, and heavy-duty filtration checks.
sources.access: Public product search plus portal/account features.
sources.limits: Use as heavy-duty filter analog/applicability evidence; confirm OEM service-kit contents separately.
sources.notes: Good layer for Cummins and heavy-duty filter cross checks after OEM/reference number is known.

sources.name: NGK/NTK Part Finder
sources.role: Official NGK/NTK route for spark plugs, glow plugs, ignition, oxygen sensors, exhaust sensors, MAF/MAP sensors, EGR, speed/position sensors, and cross lists.
sources.access: Public regional part finder; country coverage and disclaimers vary.
sources.limits: Use for ignition/sensor analog and applicability checks after exact vehicle profile is known.
sources.notes: Catalog explicitly exposes product catalogue, article-name search, and cross-list routes.

sources.name: BMW AIR/ETK via AOS
sources.role: Authorized BMW/MINI route for VIN-specific vehicle identity, equipment, OEM catalog part numbers, and service information.
sources.access: Paid authorized AOS login; credentials and contract must stay outside Git.
sources.limits: Use only with authorized access. Treat output as high-confidence catalog evidence, but keep source/date in CRM notes.
sources.notes: Preferred BMW/MINI confirmation route when OEM numbers are VIN-critical.

sources.name: Volkswagen Group ETKA
sources.role: Authorized Volkswagen Group EPC route for VIN/PR-code-specific OEM part verification.
sources.access: Paid authorized ETKA or partslink24 access; credentials and screenshots must stay outside Git unless redacted.
sources.limits: VIN, PR codes, gearbox/engine codes, and production date are required before confirming DSG mechatronic or other configuration-sensitive parts.
sources.notes: Preferred VAG route for DSG, gearbox, electronics, and other PR-code-sensitive catalog decisions.

sources.name: Toyota EPC Mirror
sources.notes: Public Toyota catalog mirror with frame-number search entry.

sources.name: Hyundai EPC Mirror
sources.notes: Public Hyundai catalog mirror with VIN search entry.

sources.name: Kia EPC Mirror
sources.notes: Public Kia catalog mirror with VIN search entry.

sources.name: Renault EPC Mirror
sources.notes: Public Renault catalog mirror with model and VIN-oriented catalog navigation.

sources.name: Parts-Catalogs API
sources.role: VIN/FRAME entry into OEM catalogs and catalog group/part lookup.
sources.access: paid subscription/API access through Tradesoft/Parts-Catalogs; confirm contract and API auth before integration.
sources.limits: Commercial catalog; requires subscription; exact brand coverage and Russian/Krasnoyarsk pricing must be tested separately.
sources.notes: Primary candidate for OEM lookup when the task starts from CRM VIN/frame and a requested part group.

sources.name: PARTSAPI.RU
sources.role: VIN/OE decode, TecDoc-style catalog, applicability, crosses, CROSSBASE-style analogs, and part metadata.
sources.access: API key from PARTSAPI account; demo keys may be available in cabinet.
sources.limits: Not a закупка source by itself unless connected price/stock data is explicitly available; validate license and regional data freshness.
test_vin_checks: VINdecodeOE result for common Toyota/Kia/Hyundai VIN
getPartsbyVIN filtered by service part group
sources.notes: Good MVP candidate for cross/applicability layer after OEM candidate is found.

sources.name: 17VIN API
sources.role: VIN decoding and VIN-based OE parts/category lookup, including common-wear parts by VIN.
sources.access: Commercial API account/token; test account required.
sources.limits: China-hosted commercial API; confirm supported brands/markets, latency, terms, and data language before relying on it for Russian workflow.
sources.notes: Useful second-source candidate and high-coverage common parts route if contract is acceptable.

sources.name: AUTOPOISK
sources.role: Professional EPC, VIN/frame identification, OEM/Cross tab, supplier statistics, and repair information under subscription.
sources.access: Legal-entity subscription/demo; RESTful API is advertised for aftermarket data, terms required.
sources.limits: Works only for business users; demo access may hide spare part numbers; not a procurement source unless supplier price data is connected and current.
sources.notes: Strong manual/semiautomatic candidate for professional catalog verification and market context.

sources.name: PartSouq manual catalog
sources.role: Manual fallback for genuine catalog lookup, part diagrams, availability, and international price sanity check.
sources.access: Public website/account; manual verification only unless a contract/API is later confirmed.
sources.limits: International availability/price is not Russian procurement; coverage can be inconsistent; use as fallback/source check, not final закупка.
sources.notes: Keep as manual fallback and visual sanity check.

sources.name: epc-data manual catalog
sources.role: Manual fallback for Japanese frame-number and selected Korean VIN catalog entry.
sources.access: Public website; manual verification only.
sources.limits: Public mirror, not official; must be cross-checked before high-confidence CRM writeback.
sources.notes: Useful JDM/KDM fallback because it explicitly exposes frame/VIN entry patterns.

crm_vin_oem_parts_lookup_backlog.adapter: read-only vehicle_info, groups, parts, diagrams; no CRM writes inside adapter.
crm_vin_oem_parts_lookup_backlog.acceptance: Given one ISO VIN and one JDM frame, return exact vehicle profile and requested service-part OEM candidates with production/option evidence.
For each test OEM, return applicability, crosses, and confidence flags without treating crosses as fitment-confirmed by default.

crm_vin_oem_parts_lookup_backlog.role: Second-source VIN-to-parts and common-wear parts candidate.
crm_vin_oem_parts_lookup_backlog.adapter: read-only VIN category/part search and replacement normalizer.
crm_vin_oem_parts_lookup_backlog.acceptance: Find plugs/pads/filters by VIN and expose replacement chain/source provenance.

crm_vin_oem_parts_lookup_backlog.role: Manual/semiautomatic professional EPC, Cross tab, and supplier-statistics candidate.
crm_vin_oem_parts_lookup_backlog.adapter: manual workflow first; API only after legal-entity subscription/demo confirms access.
crm_vin_oem_parts_lookup_backlog.acceptance: Show exact vehicle equipment and OEM/cross evidence for test VIN/frame without storing raw customer identifiers.

crm_vin_oem_parts_lookup_backlog.role: Primary authorized MAN OEM route for MAN trucks, buses, vans, and engines.
crm_vin_oem_parts_lookup_backlog.adapter: manual authorized-access checklist first; no scraping, no third-party MANTIS dumps.
crm_vin_oem_parts_lookup_backlog.acceptance: Given an authorized MAN VIN or production number, confirm service-kit/filter/brake OEM candidates and cite only compact source metadata.

crm_vin_oem_parts_lookup_backlog.role: Official MAN Genuine Parts ordering and inventory handoff after OEM identification.
crm_vin_oem_parts_lookup_backlog.adapter: manual portal workflow; keep customer number, login, baskets, and screenshots outside Git.
crm_vin_oem_parts_lookup_backlog.acceptance: Identify MAN Genuine Parts by VIN and verify local distributor/order route without leaking credentials or raw VIN.

crm_vin_oem_parts_lookup_backlog.role: Licensed aftermarket article, OE-reference, cross, and applicability layer.
crm_vin_oem_parts_lookup_backlog.adapter: contract/API review or use through existing PartsAPI/TecDoc-style provider before direct integration.
crm_vin_oem_parts_lookup_backlog.acceptance: For filters/plugs/sensors/brakes, return article, OE reference, linkage attributes, and confidence flags without promoting crosses to OEM.

crm_vin_oem_parts_lookup_backlog.adapter: manual source-route table first; direct API only when official terms allow it.
crm_vin_oem_parts_lookup_backlog.acceptance: For common wear parts, confirm selected analogs against official manufacturer catalog evidence and preserve OEM/reference separation.

crm_vin_oem_parts_lookup_backlog.role: Fallback/manual verification and international price sanity check.
crm_vin_oem_parts_lookup_backlog.acceptance: Use as second check for part diagram/OEM only; never mark as Russian закупка.
For Japan/Korea test identifiers, confirm catalog entry and require second source before high confidence.
